scope: Navin Code, CLI, skills and instructions, browser/computer live control, durable task recovery and Tauri integration
environment: Linux under WSL, native Tauri WebKit on isolated X11 displays

local_agent_eval.provider: scripted local provider using real AgentRunner and tools

validation.native_preview_harness: Waits for the X11 window to be ready and the Tauri takeover control to visibly confirm before sending keyboard input.

recovery.temporary_connection_failure: Automatic delayed retry from persisted context
recovery.process_exit: Resume saved unfinished work on gateway restart or reopening the same CLI session
recovery.uncertain_tool_result: Inspect actual outcome before attempting another mutation

limits: No comparative benchmark against Cursor or Claude Code; no general superiority or AGI claim.
Native Windows and macOS were not run on this Linux host.
Tauri native preview attaches to a real local gateway; distributable installers and packaged sidecar were not rebuilt.
No remote model quality, latency or cost benchmark was run.

reproduction.requirements: This Linux workspace, its Python environment, installed Chromium and Xvfb, the compiled debug Tauri binary, and /tmp/navin-code-preview-dist built from the unchanged Code UI. Preview scripts use isolated temporary configs and projects.
